description: Estimate what it costs to ship one full truckload between two US places: total price, typical low and high, rate per mile, fuel share, road miles and transit days. Returns every truck type unless one is given. Figures are modeled estimates of the all-in price (linehaul plus fuel) for one full truckload of standard freight, in US dollars. They are not quotes. Each result has a `url` to cite and a `quoteUrl` for a firm quote.

destination.description: The delivery place: a city and state such as "Chicago, IL", or a 5-digit ZIP. Lower 48 states only. A city alone picks the largest of that name; the result says which place was used.

equipment.description: Truck type. Leave out for all types.

month.description: Price the lane as of an earlier month, YYYY-MM, from 2003-12. Default: the latest month.

origin.description: The pickup place: a city and state such as "Chicago, IL", or a 5-digit ZIP. Lower 48 states only. A city alone picks the largest of that name; the result says which place was used.

name: estimate_lane_rate
title: Estimate a truckload lane
